status: Fourth development round after a discovered legacy regression

protocol.selection: Development labeled-box recall, then F1, then precision, restricted to versions passing both the existing webcam vehicle/scooter guard and the newly restored legacy-person guard. Exact ties prefer initial, then fewer changed fields.
protocol.new_guard: Legacy MEVA roof/fixture false person boxes must remain zero; the standing person must remain visible in >=45 frames under one ID. Reference regions are evaluation-only.
protocol.why: Earlier recall-first person initiation 0.25 resurrected old false person boxes. Preserve that failed result; restore the guard and select only using the four development sources plus old regression clips.
protocol.later_check_limitations: Later time windows of the same historically used cameras; correlated actors and viewpoints. Unopened in this experiment until the corrected profile is frozen, but not independent new-camera validation.
protocol.metric: Same pinned TrackEval grouped person/vehicle labeled-box metrics as the prior larger run. No property crossing or vehicle-type accuracy claim.

assessment.decision: Do not promote: marginal recall gain, lower F1 and precision on the later-window check. Existing defaults and earlier test profiles remain unchanged.
assessment.tracking_note: Larger boxes/tracking sample uses native FPS and published labels/ignores. These are not crossing-event scores or directly comparable to the previous four-frame foreground sample.
assessment.reproducibility: The cached detector outputs isolate changes in tracker/class thresholds; initial native detection passes were freshly computed. Each evaluated segment resets tracking.
assessment.limits: Correlated historical cameras and adjacent temporal windows; further independent representative property footage is needed before deployment.

user_decision.reason: User rejected the marginal recall increase because precision and F1 declined.
user_decision.note: The experimental selected/selected_profile fields retain the historical development winner; they do not indicate adoption. Existing general application defaults were never changed by the trial.
